answer_1.quote: The proposed reading assistant CARE is founded on accurate responses to user questions and explicit explanations of these responses.
answer_1.outputs: responses to user questions and clue chains explaining how to arrive at the responses

answer_2.quote: Besides the BLEU, Rouge-L, and BERTScore scores, we also care about whether it can save time with the help of CARE.

answer_4.quote: We further evaluate CARE in the real-world scenario by deploying it to train newly-hired CSRs
answer_4.guideline: CSRs are asked to answer user questions based on corresponding manuals, with different groups using different assistants; responses are evaluated for accuracy, time saved, and reliability via ICC score.
